title: A failed history read in the history lightbox shows its heading alone, with no words: no existing sentence is true for it
evidence: 2026-11-14 (PR 1737): HistoryPanel's load now ends the wait on a failed read and shows nothing below Health History (US-06 AC4c). No existing sentence fits: the empty state says there are no measurements, ValuePage's chart line says to check the connection (the read is of the record already held, not a fetch), and US-65's unreadableNote counts unreadable entries.
